verdict.rationale: The documented sign-in flow is an account login: the browser opens omnirush.ai/console with a device code that you approve. The ability to 'also add your own OpenAI, Anthropic or other provider keys' is bring-your-own-model-keys, which is an adjacent feature. Nothing shows a provider key or an Omnirush API key can replace the account login.

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login
